messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Yeh FBR tax office ka call hai. Aap ke naam par tax fraud ka case darj hua hai, case number TX-99213.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Fraud? Maine kabhi tax chhupaya nahi!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Proof humare paas hai. Arrest warrant jari ho gaya hai, police kal subah aayegi.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Case khatam karne ke liye abhi 25,000 rupay fine jama karo is account number par: PK00XXXX000011223344.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Itni si baat? Theek hai bhejta hoon magar time milta hai?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aaj hi within 2 hours, warna greftar ho gi. Kisi lawyer se baat na karna.
